facts: About 196,000 people in the City of Brussels (2024), 70 m above sea level
Seat of principal European Union institutions, in its European Quarter
worth_knowing: The City of Brussels is the historical centre of the Brussels-Capital Region. Like all municipalities in Brussels, it is officially bilingual in French and Dutch.
